title: The Discover page and domains will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Starting in December 2026, the [Discover page](/aws/en/discover/discover-page) and [domains](/aws/en/uc-semantics/domains) will be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

Discover is a curated browsing experience that helps users find assets across Databricks without requiring deep knowledge of catalog hierarchies. Use *domains* and *subdomains* to organize assets such as tables, dashboards, notebooks, and Genie Agents by business area, highlight key assets with custom curation, and explore AI-recommended assets.

See [Discover page](/aws/en/discover/discover-page).
